## Claims
- [source-backed] For a bigrassmannian \(v\), with \(i,j,a,b\) as specified, \(J_v\subset\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) is minimally generated by \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 220-235]
- [proved] The minimal homogeneous generating family above has degree-enumerator
  \[
  \sum_{\mu}q^{|\mu|}
  =q^{ij}\sum_{\rho\subseteq b^a}q^{|\rho|}
  =q^{ij}\binom{a+b}{a}_q.
  \]
  Consequently it has exactly \(\binom{a+b}{a}\) elements, with exactly \([q^k]\binom{a+b}{a}_q\) generators in partition-weight degree \(ij+k\).
- [proved] The formula includes \(a=0\): the family is the singleton \(\{\bar s_{i^j}\}\), and its enumerator is \(q^{ij}\).

## Strategy
Write every member uniquely as \(\mu=(i^j,\rho)\), where \(\rho\subseteq b^a\). Then \(|\mu|=ij+|\rho|\). Let
\[
F_{a,b}(q)=\sum_{\rho\subseteq b^a}q^{|\rho|}.
\]
Partitioning by whether \(\rho_1<b\) or \(\rho_1=b\) gives
\[
F_{a,b}(q)=F_{a,b-1}(q)+q^bF_{a-1,b}(q),
\quad F_{0,b}=F_{a,0}=1.
\]
Thus \(F_{a,b}(q)=\binom{a+b}{a}_q\). Setting \(q=1\) gives Pascal’s recurrence, hence \(F_{a,b}(1)=\binom{a+b}{a}\).

The requested new consequence—an exact graded cardinality formula for the source-minimal lower-adjoined family—is established.

## Gaps
This counts the specified minimal family only; it does not assert that every minimal generating family has the same degree distribution.
